questions.question: Explain two religious views on nuclear weapons.

points.text: 1) Christian pacifists (e.g. Quakers) reject nuclear weapons entirely — they can never be used justly because they are inherently disproportionate and kill civilians indiscriminately, violating Just War criteria. 2) Most Muslim scholars argue nuclear weapons violate the proportionality rule of lesser jihad and the principle of avoiding indiscriminate harm.
